citation.authors: Crabtree CD, Stoner J, Buga A, Robinson B, Decker D, Chebbi A, El-Shazly X, Murphy E, Jordan A, Bedell T, Kackley ML, McClure T, Han Y, Simonetti OP, Volek JS
citation.title: Cardiopulmonary responses to acute exogenous ketosis at rest, and during submaximal and maximal exercise

population.description: Healthy, recreationally active, non-obese adults (BMI 18-30 enrolled, age 18-65 enrolled; no hypertension, smoking or ketogenic diet). 12 completed the study and 11 were analysed (Results); Table 1 gives 1 F : 10 M, age 27.08 +/- 8.8 y and BMI 25.6 +/- 2.0 (visit 1) as mean +/- SD, without stating its n. Table 2 values are taken as n = 11 (Results: 'the full analyzed cohort was n = 11'; sample size is mentioned only where different).

protocols.name: placebo_bruce
protocols.description: Placebo arm of a crossover: after an overnight fast (10-12 h) a calorie- and volume-matched fat-based placebo drink at minute 0 (4 g carbohydrate, 50 g fat, 4 g protein as printed for 'the placebo product', whey protein concentrate and canola oil; the paper says nothing of two placebo servings, while two BO-BD servings made the 50 g dose, so these grams are taken as the whole drink); 120 min of rest; then a Bruce-protocol treadmill test begins at minute 120, 3-min stages. Activity from the placebo's measured peak VO2 in each stage (Table 2, PL, L/min), divided by the body weight 76.4 kg (Table 1, 'Test visit 1'; the paper does not say which visit was the placebo visit, visit 2 is 76.5 kg): stage 1 (minutes 120-123) 1.36 L/min = 1360/76.4 = 17.80 mL/kg/min, level (17.80 - 3.7)/31.7 = 0.4448; stage 2 (minutes 123-126) 1.93 L/min = 1930/76.4 = 25.26 mL/kg/min, level (25.26 - 3.7)/31.7 = 0.6802. Stage 3 (minutes 126-129): 2.87 L/min = 2870/76.4 = 37.57 mL/kg/min, level (37.57 - 3.7)/31.7 = 1.0683; level above 1.0: the model extrapolates here. The arm ends at minute 129, after stage 3; stages beyond it run to each person's exhaustion and are not entered. All participants completed at least the first three stages (Results 3.3). The Table 2 stage VO2 is the peak rate in each stage (Methods) and Figure 7a shows it for n = 10, not 11. The stage VO2 values are therefore an input here and are not entered as findings.

left_out.what: Heart rate and respiratory rate at maximal exercise, and the maximal oxygen uptake (Table 2, PL, 'Exercise max'); the stages beyond stage 3 run to each person's exhaustion and stay out, and the stage 4 oxygen uptake is not printed
Ventilation and tidal volume at rest and in each stage (Table 2)

Heart rate at rest at 15, 30, 60, 90 min after the drink (Figure 3)
